name: Port of Djibouti
subtitle: The seaport of Djibouti City, the reason the town was founded.

facts.label: Origin
facts.value: Developed as a coaling station, then a railhead for Ethiopia.

facts.label: Role today
facts.value: A major trans-shipment point for goods to and from Ethiopia.

facts.label: Doraleh
facts.value: A new regional port at Doraleh handles oil and containers.

parts.text: The seaport of Djibouti City, the reason the town was founded. It serves as the main trade outlet for landlocked Ethiopia; the container terminal is at Doraleh outside the city.
